source.section: D-40 Lines 4-7, 15-20; booklet PDF page 19 Line 4; PDF page 20 Lines 16-17 and Calculation I/Tax Rate Schedule; Schedule S Calculation G-1 lines a-h (PDF page 51); standard deduction PDF pages 4 and 13 (record base.deductions cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 85,000.00 + wages (spouse) 45,000.00 + dividends 2,400.00 = 132,400.00. Federal taxable income = 132,400.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 100,900.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). D-40 (married filing jointly): Line 4 federal AGI 132,400.00. Line 5 franchise tax 0.00. Line 6 other additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 7 = 132,400.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 132,400.00. Line 10 0.00 (no Social Security or railroad retirement). Lines 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 0.00. Line 14 Schedule I Calculation B Line 16 0.00. Line 15 total subtractions = 0.00. Line 16 DC AGI = 132,400.00 - 0.00 = 132,400.00. Line 17 standard (same as federal). Line 18 from Schedule S Calculation G-1: line a basic 30,000.00; lines b and d age 65 (born before January 2, 1961): you age 52 (born 1973-02-11) does not count; spouse age 49 (born 1976-07-30) does not count; line f 0; line g 1,600.00 x 0 = 0.00; line h 30,000.00 + 0.00 = 30,000.00. Line 19 DC taxable income = 132,400.00 - 30,000.00 = 102,400.00. Line 20 tax, Calculation I rate schedule as numbers: 4% x 10,000.00 = 400.00 + 6% x 30,000.00 = 1,800.00 + 6.5% x 20,000.00 = 1,300.00 + 8.5% x 42,400.00 = 3,604.00; total 7,104.00. (Over 100,000 the form itself uses Calculation I.) Lines 21-23 credits 0.00; Line 24 = 7,104.00.
